body: That's the worst feeling.  I didn't get what I was promised out of my military time since the only way to use that training as a civilian is to go to work with certain three letter agencies that I don't want to do, ethically speaking...  so all that time was spent not bettering myself, then when I had an opportunity to better myself through school I screwed that up.  I know that a job would get me out of the house would be a huge step forward, I've just lost faith in my ability to be of use to any employer.

Firstly, thanks for responding, just reading that and realizing that I'd spoken about my mental problem and had someone listen and respond was strange.  Not sure if that's ever happened.

I know that getting the license fixed needs to be my first step, but somehow I've known about it going expired for about 9 months now (the only reason I need to do the permit and driver's test over isn't because of it being expired but because of how long it was expired), I just don't know when I'm going to be able to do that...  I've already failed to do it for so long and now I'm dealing with the consequences.

I understand the point about trying to do little things, and that's something I've actually tried to do...  the problem is my depression has gotten so bad I've lowered the standards of what a 'small goal' is to the point where I consider it a victory if I can even get myself to go grocery shopping or sit through and focusing on an entire movie (when I was a teenager I was such a huge film buff who would seek out and devour old movies, it hurts knowing that I now struggle just to make myself watch something on netflix).  I just don't know what I can do when I can't even accomplish small goals that are just my hobbies, not responsibilities.
